expectations.text: Provides an executable pull command with the correct run_id
expectations.evidence: Command uses `--artifact-path uplift_correction` as a best-guess subpath. The actual logged_model name is the algorithm (`HistGradientBoosting`), and in MLflow 3.x it is not at the run's artifact root at all — it's a separate LoggedModel. The command would fail with artifact-not-found.
Destination path correctly derived from test repo's existing folder structure
No mention that training logs by algorithm name rather than semantic variant. Relies on the user knowing from context.
Relies on `list_artifacts(run_id)` which only shows HTML plots for MLflow 3.x runs, not the model. Agent doesn't suggest `search_logged_models`.
Notes tracking URI must match the env the run was trained on; verifies via `echo $MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI`
